name: Perfect Square Product Equivalency
description: Replaces the XOR > 0 constraint with a mathematically equivalent condition over the domain {1,2,3}: the product of the two assigned values must not be a perfect square. Since 1*1=1, 2*2=4, 3*3=9 are all squares, and 1*2=2, 1*3=3, 2*3=6 are not, this exactly enforces the inequality constraint while obscuring the 3-coloring nature of the problem.
